name: Brali reviewed outcome observations
description: Versioned public observations accepted only after explicit consent, schema validation, privacy review and provenance review. Ask Brali and the Protocol Runner can now prepare opt-in outcome events, but the empty observations array is still an observed zero, not synthetic usage.
notes: No demo, test, generated, analytics or repository event belongs in this file.
A downloaded event, exported protocol-run bundle, native-share action or prepared GitHub issue draft does not become a reviewed public observation automatically.
Negative, not-helpful, bad-match and no-answer outcomes are eligible when they meet the same privacy and provenance rules.
Query feedback and browser protocol execution are instrumented as explicit opt-in export paths with no automatic transmission.
Zero reviewed observations therefore remains a valid current result.
